item.title: Soul Springs Festival returns to Cathedral City for second year

item.title: City of Indio Celebrates Black History Month with Free, Family-Friendly Event

item.title: Tour de Palm Springs returns for 28th year, bringing riders and road closures to downtown
item.description: Thousands of bicyclists are in downtown Palm Springs today as the Tour de Palm Springs returns for its 28th year.The annual cycling event brings riders from across the region to the Coachella Valley and features multiple routes designed for cyclists of all skill levels. item.title: Desert Hot Springs Breaks Ground on New Eagles Sports Park
item.description: Desert Hot Springs is opening a new chapter for youth sports with the groundbreaking of the Eagles Sports Park. City officials, local leaders, and families gathered Saturday morning at the intersection of Hacienda Avenue and Cholla Drive to celebrate the start of construction.The new park will serve as the permanent home for the city’s youth football and cheerleading programs, as well as the senior baseball league for players ages 13 and older.
